text:
Situation: Our current supply of oxycodone and acetaminophen is labeled by Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407). Corvale East has 32 days on hand, Corvale General has 26 days on hand, and Corvale Lakeside has 14 days on hand at current usage rates.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 590126 at the Bryant Ranch Prepack plant ended 2009-06-11 and was classified Official Action Indicated with six observations including lack of a written stability program and complaint investigation deficiencies. Subsequent inspections from 2010 through 2026 have all been classified Voluntary Action Indicated, with the latest inspection ending 2026-07-16 and known date 2026-10-14. FDA's shortage list shows Endo Pharmaceuticals, Inc. has a product with generic name Acetaminophen; Oxycodone Hydrochloride Tablet listed as To Be Discontinued with initial posting date 2025-11-03.

Our position: Inventory at Corvale Lakeside is critically low at 14 days. Corvale East and General have approximately one month of supply. The Endo product discontinuation removes a major market supplier. Alternative manufacturers are not currently on FDA's shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Alvogen, Inc., American Health Packaging, Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, Amneal Pharmaceuticals of New York LLC, and Asclemed USA, Inc. (needs: buyer approval).
2. Buyer to request plant identification from each alternative supplier to assess supply chain reliability (needs: buyer approval).
3. Pharmacy director to approve allocation strategy prioritizing Corvale Lakeside replenishment (needs: pharmacy director approval).
4. P&T committee to review therapeutic alternatives for formulary consideration (needs: P&T committee approval).

Not recommended: Delaying procurement decisions pending further FDA updates given current inventory trajectory.
